verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents a public Cloud API with SDK calls such as client.runs.create, sessions holding multiple runs, cursor-based event polling, structured-output handling, and programmatic browser launch and CDP connection. llms.txt confirms published docs for the Cloud Agent and Browser APIs. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
